name: AI Floor Plan
summary: Generates an editable 2D and 3D floor plan from a description of rooms and area, with a free starter credit.
description: AI Floor Plan (aifloorplan.org) turns a description of rooms and total area into an editable floor plan you can adjust, walk through in 3D and export. One AI floor plan uses 20 credits; editing, 3D views and exports never use credits. Official pricing: new accounts start with 20 free credits (one plan). Subscription credits do not roll over. Free PNG/SVG exports include an aifloorplan.org mark; paid plans and credit packs include watermark-free exports during the paid credit period. The site says AI layouts are concepts and you should work with a licensed architect before construction.

pricing.details: 20 free starter credits (one plan); Starter 18 €/month (1,000 credits, up to 50 plans); Professional 44 €/month (3,000 credits, up to 150 plans). Subscription credits do not roll over. Editing, 3D views and exports use no credits. Free exports include a mark; paid plans include watermark-free exports during the paid credit period.
pricing.label: Freemium
